Citizen Lab: Israeli firm weaponized programmatic ads for zero-click spyware delivery ⭐️ 9.0/10

Citizen Lab research reveals that Israeli firm Discover Tech exploited the programmatic advertising ecosystem to create a zero-click spyware delivery pipeline. The report details how targeted ads were weaponized to install mercenary spyware without user interaction, exposing a critical supply-chain vulnerability in the ad tech infrastructure. The Guardian and The Verge have independently reported on the findings.

hackernews · jcomp · Oct 15, 10:43 · Discussion

「Background」 Citizen Lab's AdFection research documents the first publicly confirmed case of zero-click mercenary spyware delivered through programmatic advertising. The Israeli firm Discover-Tech operated the Controlium ad platform, which placed nearly four billion ad bids between March and June 2026 and was used to infect at least 45 Al Jazeera devices with Candiru and Bindecy spyware via zero-click ads. The technique exploits the real-time bidding supply chain, allowing surveillance vendors to target and compromise devices without user interaction.

「Community Discussion」 An ad tech engineer with 13 years experience argues the report is sensationalist regarding the "zero-click" claim, noting it details distribution and command-and-control but remains vague on the actual zero-click activation mechanism. Other commenters debate the broader implications of Israeli cyber firms and their relationship to state intelligence, while one user shares the direct link to the full Citizen Lab report.

Libreboot 26.10 adds UEFI support and 233 Chromebooks ⭐️ 8.0/10

Libreboot 26.10 "Ominous Olive" introduces UEFI/EDK II support and imports all 233 Chromebooks currently supported by the MrChromebox coreboot distribution, dramatically expanding the number of compatible devices. The Chromebook ports are source-only in this release, requiring users to build from source, with only the Baytrail (Kip) platform tested so far. The release also includes a strict policy against AI-assisted code contributions, which the project maintainer highlighted as a key part of the announcement.

hackernews · iamnothere · Oct 15, 12:52 · Discussion

「Background」 Libreboot is a free-software BIOS/UEFI distribution based on coreboot that removes proprietary blobs. The previous Libreboot 26.01 release was published more than eight months earlier. The MrChromebox project maintains a coreboot-based firmware distribution supporting a wide range of Chromebook models, which Libreboot 26.10 now imports in full.

「Impact」 Users gain potential Libreboot support for a large fleet of Chromebook hardware, though most ports remain untested and require building from source. The UEFI/EDK II integration simplifies future device ports by leveraging existing upstream firmware components. Developers contributing to Libreboot must now comply with the project's prohibition on LLM-generated code submissions.

「Community discussion」 Commenters emphasized that the UEFI/EDK integration and massive Chromebook import represent the most significant technical advance, overshadowing the AI contribution policy. One contributor noted active collaboration with the Heads project using MrChromebox code as an upstream dependency, while another reported successfully testing the Baytrail (Kip) Chromebook port. Opinions on the AI policy ranged from strong support to viewing it as a distraction from the hardware compatibility milestone.

  • Libreboot 26.10 Open-Source BIOS/UEFI Firmware Released with ...

MIT: Randomly connected neural units self-assemble gradient-learning motifs matching backprop performance ⭐️ 8.0/10

MIT News reports on a PNAS paper (published 9 October 2026) showing that randomly interconnected neuron-like units, governed by shared local plasticity rules, can self-assemble gradient-learning motifs and achieve pattern-recognition and image-classification performance comparable to backpropagation-trained networks. The work demonstrates a biologically plausible mechanism where learning machinery emerges from local rules rather than being hand-designed, though the authors caution that self-organization does not prove the brain uses this mechanism and the motivation is biological plausibility rather than replacing backpropagation in large-scale models.

reddit · r/MachineLearning · /u/Dorian182 · Oct 15, 10:01

「Background」 The work builds on longstanding efforts to find biologically plausible alternatives to backpropagation, which requires non-local error signals that are difficult to map onto known synaptic plasticity mechanisms. Earlier research on local learning rules, such as equilibrium propagation and predictive coding, showed that gradient-like learning can emerge from local updates, but typically assumed carefully designed architectures. This study instead demonstrates that the learning circuitry itself can self-assemble from random connectivity under shared plasticity rules, extending the principle of local credit assignment to the emergence of the learning machinery.

「Impact」 The result provides a concrete demonstration that gradient-based learning can emerge from local plasticity rules in randomly connected networks, offering a new research direction for neuromorphic computing and biologically plausible credit assignment. Researchers should evaluate motif stability across initial connectivity conditions and task generalization beyond the demonstrated classification benchmarks.

Tags: #computational neuroscience, #self-organizing systems, #credit assignment, #biologically plausible learning, #neuromorphic computing

Shanghai AI Lab Releases Atria Dawn 744B MoE Agent Model ⭐️ 8.0/10

Shanghai AI Laboratory released Atria Dawn on October 12, a 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts agent model built on the GLM-5.2 architecture. The model features a 256K-token context window, tool-use and multi-step reasoning capabilities, and is licensed under MIT for both weights and code. Official demos show it performing protein structure prediction, CAD modeling, knowledge visualization, slide creation, and data analysis, with support for local deployment and hosted access.

telegram · zaihuapd · Oct 16, 01:32

「Background」 Atria Dawn is the official release of a model first previewed on September 11, 2026, by the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. The preview version was described as a 744B-parameter MoE foundation model built on Zhipu AI's GLM-5.2 with additional agentic post-training for tool use and task execution, and it featured DeepSeek Sparse Attention. The current release makes the model weights and code available under the MIT license for local deployment and hosted access.

「Impact」 Researchers and engineers gain a permissively licensed, large-scale agent model that can be run locally or via hosted endpoints for complex scientific and engineering workflows such as structural biology, mechanical design, and automated data analysis.

SemiAnalysis: AMD MI355X beats NVIDIA Blackwell cost-efficiency on massive MoE models ⭐️ 8.0/10

SemiAnalysis released the AgentX dataset and benchmarks showing AMD's MI355X, after 26 days of open-source software optimization (70+ PRs, TileLang kernels, ATOM runtime), doubled throughput on frontier models like DeepSeek-V4-Pro. On massive MoE workloads (Kimi K3, GLM-5.3) at moderate latency, the MI355X's 288 GB memory enabled higher batch density, achieving 9–40% lower cost per million tokens than NVIDIA Blackwell. NVIDIA retains a 2–5× efficiency and cost advantage at extreme low-latency (>150 tok/s) and on massive dense models due to NVLink and FP4 support.

telegram · zaihuapd · Oct 16, 02:30

「Background」 SemiAnalysis previously released the AgentX benchmark suite and InferenceX leaderboard to evaluate inference hardware on realistic agentic workloads featuring 1M+ token contexts, multi-turn branching, and high KV-cache hit rates. Earlier Horizon coverage noted that AMD's MI355X achieved an 11× throughput gain on MiniMax M3 within 19 days through vLLM software improvements, and AMD's own technical article claimed MI355X surpassed NVIDIA GB200 NVL72, B300, and GB300 NVL72 by up to 5.6× in tokens per dollar on the public AgentX leaderboard at selected operating points.

「Impact」 Organizations serving massive MoE models such as Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 can now achieve 9–40% lower cost per million tokens on AMD MI355X hardware compared to NVIDIA Blackwell, provided their workloads fit the medium-latency, high-batch regime where MI355X's 288 GB memory capacity enables higher batch density. For latency-sensitive interactive workloads (>150 tok/s) and dense models, NVIDIA retains a 2–5× energy and cost advantage due to NVLink and FP4 support. Teams evaluating inference infrastructure should benchmark their specific model architectures and latency targets rather than assuming a universal CUDA advantage.

Meta releases Muse Spark Open 816B MoE model for local deployment ⭐️ 7.0/10

Meta has released Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 42 billion active parameters (A42B), optimized for local inference on consumer hardware such as Mac Studio. The model weights are available on Hugging Face and Meta provides deployment guides for runtimes including MLX, Unsloth, and others. However, the license restricts commercial Model-as-a-Service use when the licensee and its affiliates exceed $20 million in aggregate gross revenue. Community benchmarks indicate the model trails competitors such as Qwen3.8 Flash Next and GLM 5.3 Flash.

hackernews · bigwheels · Oct 15, 17:47 · Discussion

「Background」 Meta's Muse Spark Open is an 816-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 42 billion active parameters, released on October 15, 2026, under the Muse Model License that permits free use for many developers but restricts commercial Model-as-a-Service deployments for entities with over $20 million in aggregate gross revenue. The model is optimized for local deployment on consumer hardware such as Mac Studio and supports multiple inference runtimes including MLX and Unsloth.

「Impact」 Developers evaluating Muse Spark Open for production workloads should note that independent benchmarks show it trailing Qwen 3.8 Flash Next and GLM 5.3 Flash on shared leaderboard tests, while its license restricts commercial Model-as-a-Service use for entities with over $20M in aggregate gross revenue. The model's broad runtime support (MLX, Unsloth, etc.) and optimization for consumer hardware like Mac Studio may still make it attractive for local inference, but teams needing the highest benchmark scores or unrestricted commercial API deployment will likely prefer the competing models.

「Community discussion」 Commenters note that independent benchmarks show Muse Spark Open underperforming Qwen3.8 Flash Next and GLM 5.3 Flash, both of which can run on a single B300 GPU. The license's Model-as-a-Service revenue cap above $20 million is debated as a limitation on openness. Meta's broad runtime support (MLX, Unsloth, etc.) is praised for deployment flexibility, while some users argue Meta's strategy is to build a sticky ecosystem around its models rather than chase peak benchmark scores.

Krea 3 launches open beta for scalable image editing ⭐️ 7.0/10

Krea has released Krea 3 in open beta, a foundational image model optimized for native regional editing and precise edits at claimed frontier quality with lower latency and cost. The announcement comes from Krea founder Diego, who notes a technical report will follow similar to the Krea 2 deep-dive. The model is currently accessible via the Krea platform with a limited free trial before requiring a monthly subscription.

hackernews · dvrp · Oct 15, 16:04 · Discussion

「Background」 Krea 3 is the latest foundational image model from Krea, following Krea 2 which was accompanied by a technical report detailing its architecture and training approach. The new model is positioned as a specialized editing model that performs pixel-perfect regional edits, modifying only specified areas while preserving the rest of the original image, and can combine up to eight reference images in a single edit. It offers two thinking modes—fast and high—for different editing needs, and is currently available in open beta via Krea's platform and through partners such as Baseten and Envato.

「Impact」 Early community comparisons on Hacker News show Krea 3 lagging behind GPT-Image-2.5 in visual quality for UI design tasks, with one commenter stating "Overall Krea 3 isn't near GPT-Image-2.5 in terms of visual" quality. Users also flagged the subscription-only pricing after two trial images as a barrier, and multiple commenters emphasized that open-weights availability would be critical for adoption among developers who prefer local deployment and fine-tuning.

「Community discussion」 Community members shared direct visual comparisons between Krea 3 and GPT-Image-2.5 for UI design tasks including starship landing pages, fashion history websites, and banking interfaces. Several users expressed strong interest in open-weights availability for local deployment and anime fine-tunes, while others criticized the subscription-only pricing model after a two-image free trial, preferring credit-based alternatives.

Google Launches AI-Powered Android Anti-Scam Features ⭐️ 7.0/10

Google has rolled out new AI-driven anti-scam protections for Android. Google Messages now offers an enhanced protection mode that uses cloud-based Gemini to analyze suspicious conversations and on-device Gemini Nano to check unknown links in real time. Screen-sharing masking for passwords and payment pages has been extended to Chrome and WebView components. The system also adds background interception of call forwarding and warnings when users manually enter one-time passcodes, aiming to prevent OTP theft.

telegram · zaihuapd · Oct 15, 12:39

「Background」 Google has been progressively adding AI-driven security features to Android. In May 2026, the company outlined a broader set of AI-powered protections and advanced safeguards for the platform, including on-device and cloud-based threat analysis. The newly announced anti-scam capabilities — on-device link scanning with Gemini Nano, cloud-based message analysis in Google Messages, expanded screen-sharing masking in Chrome and WebView, and call-forwarding interception with OTP warnings — build on that roadmap and are now rolling out to users.

「Impact」 Android users gain platform-level, AI-assisted scam detection across messaging, browsing, and calls without needing third-party apps. Developers using WebView should verify that password and payment fields are correctly identified for automatic masking during screen sharing.

References
  • Android Show: New Android Security and Privacy Features in 2026

Tags: #Android, #Security, #AI, #Google, #Mobile

Tesla Unveils SpaceX Thruster-Equipped Roadster ⭐️ 7.0/10

Tesla revealed a second-generation Roadster equipped with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at an event near Waco, Texas. The demonstration showed the vehicle driving up an inverted ramp, rotating mid-air, and landing smoothly, as well as jumping over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, and Model Y. Tesla claims a 0-60 mph time of approximately one second, a top speed exceeding 230 mph, and 300 miles of range across three variants. Production is targeted for 2028; pricing was not disclosed, though reservations require a $50,000 deposit and a top-tier "Rocket" version is invitation-only.

telegram · zaihuapd · Oct 16, 02:02

「Background」 Tesla first announced a second-generation Roadster in 2017, promising a 2020 launch that was repeatedly delayed. The new reveal at SpaceX's McGregor, Texas facility marks the first public demonstration of the vehicle with integrated cold-gas thrusters, a concept Elon Musk has discussed since 2018 as a "SpaceX package" to augment acceleration, cornering, and braking beyond tire-grip limits.

「Impact」 The 2028 production target and lack of independent verification mean the claimed performance figures remain unproven for a production vehicle. The $50,000 reservation deposit and invitation-only top trim limit immediate accessibility, while the integration of cold-gas thrusters on a road-legal car faces unresolved regulatory and safety certification challenges.

Scaling Kimi K3 on AMD MI355X: Matching B300 Throughput ⭐️ 8.0/10

rss · vLLM Blog · Oct 16, 00:00

「Background」 AMD and vLLM collaborators optimized Kimi K3, a 93-layer model mixing 24 MLA attention layers (growing KV cache) with 69 KDA recurrent layers (fixed state), on an eight-GPU AMD Instinct MI355X system. The AgentX benchmark replays real coding-agent traces with high prefix reuse. At 50 tokens/s/user P90 interactivity, MI355X achieved 7,567 total tokens/s/GPU versus 6,083 for NVIDIA HGX B300 (24.4% higher), translating to 87.4% more tokens per dollar under SemiAnalysis TCO estimates ($1.50 vs $2.26/GPU-hour). Both GPUs share 288 GB HBM3E and 8 TB/s bandwidth, though B300 has higher dense matrix peaks (13.5 PFLOP/s FP4 vs 10.1 PFLOP/s MXFP4).

「Solution」 Six kernel-level optimizations closed the gap. (1) Decode Context Parallelism (DCP8) splits MLA history across GPUs, cutting per-GPU cache from ~1.96 GB to ~245 MB for a 142K-token conversation; CPU offload preserves reusable state in host DRAM with aligned MLA/KDA resume points. (2) MoE output projection deduplication assigns each GPU its output coordinates, using the existing shared-expert all-reduce to assemble the full result—eliminating 8× redundant projections and freeing ~3.85 GiB/GPU for cache (3.05–4.91% throughput gain, up to 28.9% at high concurrency). (3) Kernel fusion removed intermediate copies: KDA decode fused three kernels into one (AttnRes+RMSNorm kept mixtures in FP32 registers), and the GEMM dispatcher stopped packing unused fallback inputs (69 copies/step, 0.339 ms saved). (4) Padding MLA query heads from 12 to 16 unlocked AMD AITER's assembly decode path, halving long-context decode latency (43.8→23.6 ms/token at 32K input). (5) KDA prefill/verification parallelization: fused prefill computes group transformations before state arrives, then an ordered scan assigns starting states for parallel replay; speculative verification switched to 4-column tiles, raising workgroups from 48 to 384 and delivering 2.89× verification speedup (16.2→5.61 µs/layer). (6) Speculative decoding economics: with AgentX's fixed acceptance, 4 drafts yield 12% more committed tokens per cycle than 3, so the full cycle must grow <12% to justify the extra draft; the recipe uses 3–7 drafts at DCP1 but disables speculation at DCP8.

「Takeaway」 Matching NVIDIA's throughput on competitive hardware required eliminating redundant work across the stack—duplicate cache storage, repeated MoE projections, unnecessary kernel handoffs, and underutilized compute units—rather than chasing peak FLOPs. The optimizations demonstrate that inference efficiency comes from aligning serving decisions (cache policy, parallelism strategy, draft depth) with kernel scheduling and memory hierarchy, and that the same principles (compare ranks, follow buffers, count independent work) transfer to other models and workloads.

Tags: #LLM inference optimization, #AMD GPU kernels, #vLLM, #Mixture of Experts, #speculative decoding

Financial News

Chinese households spend nearly as much of income on healthcare as Americans, IMF finds ⭐️ 7.0/10

IMF research shows rural Chinese households spend 8.7% of disposable income on healthcare — second only to the U.S. at 9.9% — despite per capita income being roughly one-tenth of U.S. levels ($6,400 vs $68,289).

rss · CNBC Finance · Oct 15, 23:00

「Background」 The findings come from an IMF book on China's growth model, which links high out-of-pocket health costs to elevated household savings rates — 14% for rural migrant workers versus 6% for urban hukou holders — and argues that raising social spending in rural areas would boost consumption.

「Impact」 The heavy healthcare burden on low-income rural households suppresses domestic consumption and reinforces China's high savings rate, a structural drag on the country's shift toward consumption-led growth.

Tags: #China, #healthcare costs, #IMF, #household savings, #economic rebalancing

Citizen Lab 报告揭露以色列公司利用程序化广告投放零点击间谍软件 ⭐️ 9.0/10

Citizen Lab 发布研究报告，揭露以色列公司 Discover Tech 利用程序化广告生态系统构建零点击间谍软件投放管道。该管道通过定向广告在无需用户交互的情况下向目标设备植入雇佣间谍软件，暴露了广告技术供应链的关键漏洞。报告指出合法广告基础设施被大规模武器化，对隐私、安全及数字广告信任模型构成重大威胁。

hackernews · jcomp · 10月15日 10:43 · 社区讨论

「背景：程序化广告与零点击间谍软件」 程序化广告生态系统通过实时竞价（RTB）在毫秒级时间内完成广告位拍卖与投放，广告内容常包含可执行代码（如 JavaScript），并可获取设备指纹、IP 等元数据。以色列监控软件厂商 Candiru 此前已因向政府客户提供零点击间谍软件（如 DevilsTongue）而被美国列入实体清单。Citizen Lab 此前曾披露 Candiru 利用浏览器漏洞实施定向攻击，但 AdFection 技术首次证实攻击者可直接利用合法广告投放管道，在受害者完全无感知的情况下完成恶意代码投放与设备感染。

「影响」 这一发现表明程序化广告系统可被滥用为大规模监控工具，广告技术供应链的各方（包括广告交易平台、需求方平台、发布商）均面临被利用风险。用户在浏览含广告页面时可能在不知情情况下遭受零点击攻击，传统防御措施（如避免点击可疑链接）对此类威胁失效。

「社区讨论」 Hacker News 评论中，资深 AdTech 工程师指出报告对“零点击”机制的技术细节披露不足，且强调广告生态系统极其复杂，不存在单一“广告提供商”可追责。另有评论讨论以色列网络产业与国家安全机构的关联，质疑其公司独立性；也有观点认为以色列网络能力源于长期生存压力。

Libreboot 26.10 发布：新增 UEFI/EDK 与 233 款 Chromebook 支持 ⭐️ 8.0/10

Libreboot 26.10 “Ominous Olive” 正式发布，引入 UEFI/EDK 支持并从 MrChromebox coreboot 发行版导入 233 款 Chromebook 设备，大幅扩展硬件兼容性。此版本仅提供源代码，用户需自行编译，暂无预编译二进制文件。发布同时包含一项关于 AI 辅助贡献的严格政策，引发社区广泛讨论。

「背景」 Libreboot 是一个基于 coreboot 的自由固件发行版，旨在为 x86 和 ARM 设备提供完全自由的启动固件。此前的 Libreboot 26.01 版本发布于 2026 年 1 月，主要维护现有硬件支持。MrChromebox 是一个长期维护的 coreboot 衍生项目，专注于为数百款 Chromebook 提供 coreboot 固件及 UEFI 启动支持。此次 Libreboot 26.10 将 MrChromebox 支持的全部 233 款 Chromebook 导入代码库，并新增 UEFI/EDK II 支持，标志着 Libreboot 硬件兼容性的大幅扩展。

在 AMD MI355X 上扩展 Kimi K3：六大内核优化匹敌 NVIDIA B300 吞吐 ⭐️ 8.0/10

rss · vLLM Blog · 10月16日 00:00

「背景」 在 AgentX 基准测试（复现真实编码代理会话）中，八卡 AMD Instinct MI355X 以 vLLM 服务 Kimi K3，在 50 tokens/s/user P90 交互性下实现约 7,567 total tokens/s/GPU，比 NVIDIA HGX B300 的 6,083 高出 24.4%；按 SemiAnalysis 的 TCO 模型（$1.50 与 $2.26/GPU-hour），每美元吞吐更高 87.4%。两款 GPU 均为 288 GB HBM3E、8 TB/s 带宽，但 MI355X 密集矩阵峰值 10.1 PFLOP/s MXFP4 低于 B300 的 13.5 PFLOP/s FP4，性能反超完全依赖软件栈优化。

「方案」 作者拆解了六层内核级优化：1) 缓存层引入 8 路解码上下文并行（DCP8），将 MLA 压缩 KV 历史按位置分片，单 GPU 显存占用从 ~1.96 GB 降至 ~245 MB；配合原生 CPU offload 在主机内存保留 MLA 与 KDA 检查点，并对齐恢复点避免前缀重算。2) MoE 层消除跨 GPU 重复投影：利用现有 shared-expert all-reduce 仅让各 rank 计算自己负责的输出坐标，再经一次 all-reduce 组装完整结果，吞吐提升 3.05–4.91%，并腾出 ~3.85 GiB/GPU 显存用于缓存，高并发下命中率从 74.8% 升至 80.1%。3) 片上融合消除内核间拷贝：KDA 单 token 路径从 3 计算内核+2 次拷贝融合为 1 次启动，AttnRes 与 RMSNorm 融合保持中间结果在寄存器，再移除 ROCm GEMM 调度器中 69 次/步的冗余打包拷贝（每次 1.7 KB 但启动开销主导），单步节省 0.339 ms。4) MLA 长上下文解码用 AMD AITER 汇编路径：将每 GPU 12 个查询头补齐到 16 头解锁汇编内核，配合更激进的历史分区并行策略，32K/1K 测试中单 token 延迟从 43.8 ms 降至 23.6 ms。5) KDA 循环状态并行化：预填阶段按 token 组合并线性变换，再以有序扫描确定各组初始状态并行回放，输入吞吐提升 5.3–5.6%；推测验证再将 128 列 value 切为 4 列 tile，工作组从 48 增至 384，单层验证耗时 16.20→5.61 μs（2.89×）。6) 推测解码草稿深度权衡：在固定接受率参考下，4 草稿比 3 草稿多 12% 提交 token，仅当完整周期增幅 <12% 时才收益；实测配方在 DCP1 用 3–7 草稿，DCP8 高并发则关闭推测。

「启示」 通过系统性地在缓存分片、MoE 去重、内核融合、注意力汇编路径、循环状态并行化和推测深度经济性六个维度消除冗余工作与调度瓶颈，AMD 与 vLLM 社区让峰值算力劣势的 MI355X 在真实代理负载上实现了超越 B300 的每 GPU 吞吐与显著更优的每美元性能，展示了把服务层决策下沉到 GPU 内核与硬件特性的工程杠杆作用。

「影响」 IMF 建议增加农村医疗和社保财政支出，可显著降低农村家庭储蓄率，从而提振消费、推动经济结构再平衡。
